case_title: CARLOS ALEMAN NAVARRO VS. IVANNA M. MECCHIPARLER

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY NAVARRO, CARLOS ALEMAN AS TO DEFENDANT MECCHIPARLER, IVANNA M. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-23-2010 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $42.00) SERVED MAY-24-2010, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT MECCHIPARLER, IVANNA M.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-23-2010 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-23-2010 BY PAUL SLAVIT. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-23-2010 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NAVARRO, CARLOS ALEMAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MECCHIPARLER, IVANNA M. $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $117.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,117.00, THE JUDGMENT REPRESENTS DAMAGES FOR GENERAL AND SPECIAL DAMAGES FOR PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FOR PERSONAL INJURIES. NO EVIDENCE WAS OFFERED ESTABLISH THE COST TO REPAIR PLAINTIFF'S VEHICLE, AND THAT PORTION OF HIS CLAIM IS DISMISSED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT MECCHIPARLER, IVANNA M.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED OCT-01-2010 ORDERED DESTROYED
